HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Bouncemasters is an exciting arcade game where penguins perform crazy jumps across frozen lands. Join the adventure and see how far you can fly!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Tap the screen at the right time to hit the stick and make the penguin fly.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Control the penguin during flight to touch objects like seals or whales for extra bounce.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Avoid ice, rocks, and water to keep flying and collect coins to upgrade your gear.
